install_tell: docker run -p 8500:8500 hashicorp/consul:latest agent -dev (dev mode = ACLs off, HTTP API fully open)
misconfig_patterns: ACL system is DISABLED by default unless operator runs 'consul acl bootstrap' — full unauth HTTP API by default, not just an 'allow' policy edge case
Pre-1.9 shipped guidance defaulted acl_default_policy to 'allow' even once ACLs were turned on — legacy long-lived clusters often never rotated this
-dev mode (common in quick-start docs, copy-pasted into prod) disables ACLs entirely and binds 0.0.0.0
/v1/kv/?recurse=true dumps entire KV store including app secrets operators store there (anti-pattern, but observed in the wild)
/v1/catalog/services + /v1/agent/members leak full service mesh topology and node membership without auth

active_probe.false_positive_check: GET /v1/agent/self must return JSON with top-level 'Config' and 'Member' keys and a 'Consul' version string under Config -- unique to Consul agent API, unauth response confirms ACL-off state directly (200 here = ACLs disabled or default token has read)

deployment_tells: GET :8500/v1/agent/self -> 200 with full JSON config (Datacenter, NodeName, Consul version) confirms unauth read
GET :8500/v1/kv/?recurse=true -> 200 = KV store fully open (vs 403 = ACLs enforced)
GET :8500/v1/catalog/services -> service name list -> topology map without a single auth token
GET :8500/v1/agent/members -> full cluster node list incl. internal IPs, tags, build version
UI at :8500/ui/ renders the same data visually — confirms operator-facing, not just an API artifact
pivot_paths: /v1/catalog/service/{name} -> per-service instance IPs:ports -> direct pivot to backend services registered in the mesh
/v1/kv/?recurse=true -> frequently contains DB connection strings, feature flags, and (anti-pattern) plaintext secrets
/v1/agent/members -> internal RFC1918 IP disclosure -> maps the private network from a public listener
Consul Connect / service-mesh intentions (if exposed) reveal authorization topology between services
vulnerabilities: CVE-2020-25864 / CVE-2020-25865 (Consul Connect proxy) — noted for chain awareness, not this survey's primary vector
No CVE required for KV/catalog/members disclosure — default-config finding
